1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: """Deterministic generator for the two retained YCbCr
3: (PhotometricInterpretation = 6) test fixtures.
4: 
5: Generates:
6: 
7: * ``tests/ycbcr_images/`` - a full-resolution stripped YCbCr TIFF and a tiled
8:   YCbCr TIFF (both 64x48, 1x1 subsampling, all other YCbCr tags at defaults)
9: * ``tests/reference_images/`` - ground-truth ASCII Netpbm PPM (P3) RGB reference
10:   images for each generated fixture
11: 
12: The TIFF images are created with ImageMagick (``magick``) from a deterministic
13: source image; the ground-truth reference images are also created with
14: ImageMagick from that source image and written as Netpbm ASCII PPM (P3).
15: 
16: Only attributes that ImageMagick can actually write into the TIFF are emitted.
17: A tag-level audit showed that ImageMagick cannot write YCbCrSubSampling,
18: YCbCrPositioning, YCbCrCoefficients, ReferenceBlackWhite, or PlanarConfiguration
19: = 2; the variant cases that claimed those attributes were removed rather than
20: kept with a false claim. Tiling is the one variant attribute ImageMagick can
21: write, so the tiled fixture is retained.
22: 
23: Usage:
24: 
25:     python3 tests/ycbcr_images/generate_ycbcr.py
26: """
27: 
28: import subprocess
29: import zlib
30: from pathlib import Path
31: 
32: BASE_W, BASE_H = 64, 48
33: IMAGE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
34: REFERENCE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "reference_images"
35: TMP_DIR = Path("/tmp/opencode")
36: 
37: # (name, tiled). Only these two combinations are truthfully writable by
38: # ImageMagick: full-resolution stripped YCbCr, and the same image with real
39: # TIFF tile tags. The variant cases (subsampling, positioning, coefficients,
40: # RefBW, planar=2) were removed after a tag-level audit because ImageMagick
41: # cannot write those tags.
42: CASES = [
43:     ("ycbcr-1x1", False),
44:     ("ycbcr-tiled", True),
45: ]
46: 
47: 
48: def run_magick(args):
49:     subprocess.run(["magick", *args], check=True)
50: 
51: 
52: def write_binary_ppm(path, w, h, pixels):
53:     with open(path, "wb") as f:
54:         f.write(f"P6\n{w} {h}\n255\n".encode("ascii"))
55:         for row in pixels:
56:             for (r, g, b) in row:
57:                 f.write(bytes((r, g, b)))
58: 
59: 
60: def write_ascii_ppm(path, w, h, pixels):
61:     lines = ["P3", f"{w} {h}", "255"]
62:     for row in pixels:
63:         lines.append(" ".join(f"{r} {g} {b}" for (r, g, b) in row))
64:     path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
65: 
66: 
67: def source_pixels(w, h, seed):
68:     return [
69:         [
70:             (
71:                 int((x * 37 + y * 11 + seed * 53) % 256),
72:                 int((x * 7 + y * 29 + seed * 17) % 256),
73:                 int((x * 13 + y * 5 + seed * 31) % 256),
74:             )
75:             for x in range(w)
76:         ]
77:         for y in range(h)
78:     ]
79: 
80: 
81: def main():
82:     IMAGE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
83:     REFERENCE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
84:     for name, tiled in CASES:
85:         w, h = BASE_W, BASE_H
86:         pixels = source_pixels(w, h, zlib.crc32(name.encode()) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
87:         src = TMP_DIR / f"{name}-src.ppm"
88:         out_tif = IMAGE_DIR / f"{name}.tif"
89:         out_ppm = REFERENCE_DIR / f"{name}.ppm"
90: 
91:         write_binary_ppm(src, w, h, pixels)
92: 
93:         args = [str(src), "-compress", "none", "-colorspace", "YCbCr"]
94:         if tiled:
95:             args += ["-define", "tiff:tile-geometry=64x48"]
96:         args += [str(out_tif)]
97:         run_magick(args)
98: 
99:         ref_bin = TMP_DIR / f"{name}-ref.ppm"
100:         run_magick([str(src), str(ref_bin)])
101:         write_ascii_ppm(out_ppm, w, h, pixels)
102: 
103: 
104: if __name__ == "__main__":
105:     main()

1: # YCbCr (PhotometricInterpretation = 6) Support Reference
2: 
3: This document describes YCbCr (`PhotometricInterpretation = 6`) images as
4: defined by the TIFF 6.0 specification.
5: 
6: ## Scope
7: 
8: - YCbCr image encoding as defined by the TIFF 6.0 specification.
9: - Conversion between RGB and YCbCr.

52: ### Forward conversion (RGB -> YCbCr), ITU-R BT.601
53:

1: # Changelog
2: 
3: All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.
4: 
5: The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
6: and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
7: 
8: Given a version number MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, increment the:
9: 
10:     MAJOR version when you make incompatible API changes.
11:     MINOR version when you add functionality in a backward compatible manner.
12:     PATCH version when you make backward compatible bug fixes.
13: 
14: ## [0.2.0-Unreleased]
15: 
16: ### Added
17: 
18: - Code examples
19: - README now documents which headers are needed and the copy-only
20:   consumption path (header-only; copy the headers into the project, no build
21:   step required).
22: - CMake consumption improvements: added the `TiffCraft::TiffCraft` namespaced
23:   alias, an installable/exportable target with generated
24:   `TiffCraftConfig.cmake`/`TiffCraftConfigVersion.cmake` (for `find_package`),
25:   and a `TIFFCRAFT_BUILD_ALL` option that defaults to `ON` when building
26:   TiffCraft standalone and to `OFF` when consumed via `FetchContent` or
27:   `add_subdirectory`.
28: - Version-consistency test between the CMake `PROJECT_VERSION` and the header
29:   version constants (`TiffCraft::version()`), failing with both values named on
30:   mismatch.
31: - YCbCr (PI=6) test coverage: added the TIFF 6.0 `tests/YCBCR_SUPPORT.md`
32:   specification reference, 2 generated YCbCr test images under
33:   `tests/ycbcr_images/`, and the corresponding `ycbcr-*.ppm` ground-truth
34:   reference images (child issue of the YCbCr support effort, #38).
35: 
36: ### Changed
37: 
38: - CMake project version bumped to `0.2.0` to match the header version
39:   constants and the `[0.2.0-Unreleased]` changelog section.
40: 
41: ### Fixed
42: 
43: - Expanded the `ReferenceBlackWhite` scaling documentation in
44:   `tests/YCBCR_SUPPORT.md` with the full code-to-full-range formulas, documented
45:   ImageMagick's tag-writing limitations, and removed or relabeled inaccurate
46:   YCbCr fixtures after a tag-level audit (#42).
47: - `TiffExporter.hpp` no longer includes the umbrella header `TiffCraft.hpp`;
48:   it now includes `TiffImage.hpp` directly, resolving the include cycle and
49:   making the exporter header standalone.
50: - ODR violations in headers: `inline` on `version()`, `readAt()`, `writeAt()`,
51:   and both `load()` overloads (`TiffImage.hpp`); the six `operator<<` overloads
52:   moved into `namespace TiffCraft` and marked `inline` (`TiffStdOut.hpp`).
53:   Note: the stream operators are no longer visible in the global namespace;
54:   they are found via ADL, which applies to all TiffCraft types.
55: - Crash/hang fixes for malformed TIFF input: ASCII entry with count 0 no
56:   longer reads out of bounds (throws `std::runtime_error`); RATIONAL/SRATIONAL
57:   entries with a zero denominator no longer divide by zero (throws
58:   `std::runtime_error`); cyclic IFD offsets are detected and rejected (throws
59:   `std::runtime_error`).
60: - `readAt()` now detects short reads and throws `std::runtime_error`, so
61:   truncated strips/tiles no longer silently yield zero-filled buffers.
62: - `takeImage()` no longer copies instead of moving; it moves the image buffer
63:   out of the exporter, leaving it empty.
64: - `TiffExporterAny` now resets its multi-IFD state per IFD; each IFD is
65:   exported and the last successfully exported image wins (previously later
66:   IFDs were silently skipped).
67: - Example `tiff_image` reads `ImageWidth`/`ImageLength` type-agnostically, so
68:   LONG-typed entries no longer throw.
69: - README quick-start snippet fixed (removed undeclared `loadParams` argument;
70:   fixed `iffExporter` typo).
71: - `Type::BYTE` entries print as integers instead of raw characters.
72: 
73: ## [0.1.0]
74: 
75: ### Added
76: 
77: - Initial TiffCraft code for loading TIFF images and exporter for bilevel,
78:   grayscale, palette-color, and RGB images. Compression is not supported.
79: - Example `tiff_exporter` program to convert TIFF images to PNG 8-bit format.
80: 
81: ### Changed
82: 
83: - Moved all headers to `include/tiffcraft`.

133: ## Generating the test images
134: 
135: `tests/ycbcr_images/generate_ycbcr.py` recreates the fixture set. It requires
136: Python 3 and ImageMagick (`magick` on `PATH`). From the repository root, run:
137: 
138: ```sh
139: python3 tests/ycbcr_images/generate_ycbcr.py
140: ```
141: 
142: The script writes the YCbCr TIFFs to `tests/ycbcr_images/` and the matching
143: Netpbm ASCII PPM (P3) ground-truth images to `tests/reference_images/`. It uses
144: a fixed source pattern, so rerunning it reproduces the same files. It emits
145: three fixtures — one stripped full-resolution image and two tiled images (a
146: single-tile variant and a 12-tile variant) — whose attributes ImageMagick can
147: actually write into the TIFF; cases for attributes it cannot write were removed
148: after the tag-level audit below.
149: 
150: ## ImageMagick limitations
151: 
152: The following was verified with ImageMagick 7.1.2-35. Only attributes that
153: ImageMagick really writes into the TIFF are represented in the fixture set. For
154: every attribute it cannot write, the corresponding case was **removed** rather
155: than kept with a false claim.
156: 
157: - **YCbCrCoefficients (529):** ImageMagick uses the ITU-R BT.601 defaults;
158:   `-define tiff:YCbCrCoefficients=...` does not write the tag. Custom
159:   coefficients are not feasible with ImageMagick, so that case was removed.
160: - **ReferenceBlackWhite (532):** ImageMagick does not write the tag;
161:   `-define tiff:ReferenceBlackWhite=...` does not work. Custom or non-default
162:   reference black/white values are not feasible, so that case was removed.
163: - **YCbCrPositioning (531):** cosited positioning (`2`) cannot be set with
164:   `-define` or `-set`. No alternative exists, so the co-sited case was removed.
165: - **PlanarConfiguration (284):** separate planes (`2`) cannot be set with
166:   `-interlace Plane` or `-define tiff:planar-configuration=separate`. The planar
167:   case was removed rather than mislabeled.
168: - **YCbCrSubSampling (530):** non-1x1 subsampling cannot be set; even
169:   `-sampling-factor 2x2` leaves the tag at `[1, 1]`. The old generator used
170:   `-resize`, which physically shrank the images instead of writing the tag —
171:   misleading — so all subsampled cases were removed.
172: - **Tiling:** tiling **can** be set with `-define tiff:tile-geometry=<value>`
173:   using any 16-multiple tile geometry (verified with ImageMagick 7.1.2-35):
174:   `-define tiff:tile-geometry=64x48` yields a single 64x48 tile (`TileWidth` =
175:   64, `TileLength` = 48, one tile offset, no `RowsPerStrip`), and
176:   `-define tiff:tile-geometry=16x16` yields a 4x3 grid of 16x16 tiles
177:   (`TileWidth` = 16, `TileLength` = 16, 12 tile offsets). This is the only
178:   variant attribute ImageMagick can write, and both geometries are used for
179:   the retained tiled fixtures.
